name: Deadpool Dating Simulator
source: You're new to the Mutant Academy, and looking for love. Deadpool is all for a good time, until Wolverine shows up to get in on the action. Your choices will decided the fate of CryoSpectre's love life.
translation: 你刚来到变种人学院，正在寻找爱情。死侍只想享受一段快乐时光，直到金刚狼出现并加入这场行动。你的选择将决定CryoSpectre的恋爱生活。
